## Download {#download legacy="7c9ba8cc"}

Get [quadriga_lib-{{ version }}.zip]({{ download_base_url }}/quadriga_lib-{{ version }}.zip) or an older one from the [release archive]({{ releases_url }}). The sources are on [GitHub]({{ github_url }}).

## Quick start {#quick-start legacy="fdc96a45"}

The [quick start of the home page](index.html#quickstart) shows the same; the API is in the [C++ reference](cpp_api.html#.interpolate).

### Python

```python
import quadriga_lib
```

### C++

```bash
g++ -I armadillo-{{ armadillo_version }}/include main.cpp
```
